description: Add daily loratadine 10 mg for seasonal allergies
presentation: A 40-year-old man with erectile dysfunction presents with two elevated fasting morning prolactin measurements (27 ng/mL, then 30 ng/mL, ref range 2-18 ng/mL). He has no visual symptoms, headache, or renal disease. He takes loratadine 10 mg daily for seasonal allergies but no other medications or supplements. Does patient need a brain MRI for prolactinoma?
